content:
Maya (Growth): Quick idea: launch a compact newsletter + gated webinar push for the benchmark drop. Want a "sparkline" microflow: registrants get 3 emails, clickers who don't finish sign-up get a 2-email rescue. Keep cadence tight and timezone-aware.
Jordan (Lifecycle): Segment proposal: High-intent = clicked CTA or went to pricing; Mid = visited landing >1x; Low = registered only. VIP slice for Enterprise so we can swap in concierge CTA. Rescue flow = immediate finish-signup nudge, then 48h highlight.
Nora (Content): I'll draft short confirm copy, a 48h highlight with 2 charts, and a day-of TL;DR. For VIP we'll add a one-line concierge invite. Subject test ideas: (A) "Benchmark snapshot + one chart" (B) "What your peers shipped" (C short) "Benchmark highlights".
Priya (Design): Creating two header styles: "sparkline chart" and "team-story" hero. Will build mobile-first templates and an AMP-lite RSVP button. Also a tiny case study block that swaps for Dedicated customers.
Alex (Analytics): UTMs: utm_campaign=sparkline_launch_v1&utm_medium=email&utm_source=newsletter. Lead scoring: click +3, rsvp +6, attend +18. Targets: High 17% RSVP, Mid 7%, Low 2.5%. Audience est ~50k (5.2k high, 14k mid). We'll seed 45 internal addresses for QA.
Maya (Growth): Send windows: local 10am preferred; APAC 10:30 local. Avoid Mon for Enterprise. No-show microflow: immediate recording email + 12-day product use-case follow-up; VIPs get AE outreach 3 days after no-show.
Jordan (Lifecycle): Automation notes: tag `webinar_status=registered` -> enroll sparkline_nurture_v1. Click webhook -> /hooks/finish-signup. Dedicated clicks -> /ae/handoff. Create routing rule to increment lead_score per Alex.
Nora (Content): CTA variants: "See benchmark highlights", "Save my seat", "Quick trial". Include a one-sentence CEO quote in high-intent confirm.
Alex (Analytics): I'll set up a live dashboard (RSVP, CTR, click->rsvp, trial starts 7d). Running subject A/B with RSVP as the primary lift metric.
Maya (Growth): Owners: Maya (campaign lead), Jordan (automation), Nora (copy), Priya (creative), Alex (metrics). Can we get final assets and test sends by Wednesday EOD?
campaign-bot: Ticket MK-5488 created for campaign config + seedlist: https://app.redwood/boards/MK-5488 :white_check_mark:
Priya (Design): :thumbsup: I'll post mockups by end of day tomorrow.
Jordan (Lifecycle): I'll prep the routing and do test sends after assets land.
